message.content:
The service gets restarted a few times a week—usually in the morning, sometimes in the afternoon if something’s wrong.

We don’t plan it; it just happens. The server’s not built to run forever, so we have to reboot it to keep it stable. And since it’s a single server, there’s no way around it.

It’s annoying because drones are flying during those times, and the service goes down for a minute or two. But the companies know that’s part of the deal. We just make sure we do it when we think it’ll cause the least trouble.
